ownerDecisions.question: AI spend: raise the global daily cap from $50 to $150-200 and split it into an interactive share and a background cap?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Yes: global $150, 70% reserved for interactive turns, background jobs capped at $30/day; revisit after a month of spend alerts.

ownerDecisions.question: Error tracker and uptime monitor: approve a vendor (new spend) or use Vercel built-ins only?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Use Sentry free tier plus Vercel monitoring; uptime via a free checker on /api/health. No paid tier until 1,000 users.

ownerDecisions.question: Hosted backup: buy Supabase PITR or run a scheduled pg_dump off the laptop?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Scheduled pg_dump from GitHub Actions to private storage now (no new vendor); buy PITR when the paid tier is next upgraded.

ownerDecisions.question: Coach Undo receipts PR B: restart with a server-minted write identity, or drop the receipts lane? Also: keep or retire coach target, weight and planned-meal writes?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Restart PR B scoped to the three v1 kinds with server-minted identity; keep coach target writes but route them through the Phase 12 checked writer.

ownerDecisions.question: Voice-to-voice coach (Phase 14): build, retire the spec, or defer to a native app?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Formally retire the Phase 14 spec in the voice-retirement branch; revisit only with a native app.

ownerDecisions.question: Coach streaming and json-render/A2UI: build streaming now?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Measure first; build streaming only if first-text p95 stays above 6 s after the measurement item.

ownerDecisions.question: AI-capture auto-resolve: keep the unreachable 0.95/0.30 gate, or move to a per-method measured gate? Plus Phase 4 open questions (iOS audio canary, caps, photo-grams default).
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Keep auto-resolve off until the capture eval reaches 85% top-1; then a per-method gate. Photo items default to the model grams.

ownerDecisions.question: Catalog search contract: dish-vs-ingredient penalty and generic typo fold; Phase 1 category normalization and FNDDS sizing questions.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Add a dish-marker penalty for 1-2 word queries and a 0.6 typo fold, both behind the R1 relevance gate; close the Phase 1 questions as recorded.

ownerDecisions.question: Phase 3 questions: OFF negative-cache window, recipe cooked-weight capture, FDC Branded vault key.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Keep 7 days, defer cooked weight to the recipe-yield work, name the vault key in docs.

ownerDecisions.question: Recipe search honest "no match", recipe catalog growth, over-target day flag and water-dial snap.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Show honest no-match using the catalog food words; flag over-target days; snap the dial; grow to 48 recipes after the pilot widens.

ownerDecisions.question: Clinical sign-off: who reviews condition-pack wording and the rebalance panel copy before CONDITION_PACKS_ENABLED and REBALANCE_PANEL_USER_IDS?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Ask Sasha's nutritionist to review both in one session; keep both flags off until the signed record is in docs/decisions.

ownerDecisions.question: TypeSafe health text: email privacy@typesafe.ai about terms vs ZDR DPA, set JEV_HEALTH_ATTESTED, and decide the data-use notice.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Send the email; keep JEV_HEALTH_ATTESTED unset and the local gate fail-closed until a DPA is signed; add the notice only if a vendor trains on data.

ownerDecisions.question: Open-world priors and learning scope: UK Biobank like term, cross-user taste learning T3, shopping-focus and pantry-photo gates, W15 go.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Keep the like term absent, no T3, shopping focus and pantry photo pilot-only until open-world release; run W15 once onb3 is live.

ownerDecisions.question: Tracked micronutrient set, fiber band display, coverage semantics and exercise logging ownership.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Confirm the twelve codes, gram-weighted coverage, and drop exercise logging from the export until it has an owner.

ownerDecisions.question: Legacy foods/days/settings tables exist in production but in no migration: drop, or add a baseline migration?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Back up, then drop the three empty tables in production so a rebuilt environment matches.

ownerDecisions.question: Duplicate-meal card: finish or drop?
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Finish it; the schema change goes through the normal migration review.

ownerDecisions.question: Cards v4 Board/Overview rulings: tip paging location and the 49% grey ring track.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Move paging into the full tip view; lighten the ring track to the hairline token.

ownerDecisions.question: Creatine/supplement tick (F-115).
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Defer until a second account asks for supplements.

ownerDecisions.question: Sprout sulking and the hidden Edit button.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Sprout sulks only when poked, never on food or water shortfall; keep Edit in the long-press tray.

ownerDecisions.question: Health: keep sleep stages or totals only; weight display unit.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Totals only; unit is already in user_settings.

ownerDecisions.question: Who may change goal_rate_bp_week (Phase 6 OQ4) and the adaptive TDEE R3/R9 revisit timing.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Close OQ4 as superseded by onboarding pace chips; revisit R3/R9 after 30 days of the day-complete control.

ownerDecisions.question: Four v2-onboarded accounts with 29 unchosen starter foods; the Oct 4 meal changes in Devin's data.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Leave the starter foods; Devin confirms whether the Oct 4 changes were his own.

ownerDecisions.question: Native iOS wrapper / HealthKit direct (Apple Developer account cost).
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Defer; the Shortcut path serves the PWA.

ownerDecisions.question: Review coach fast-path thresholds after 100 eligible production turns.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Hold thresholds; review when telemetry shows 100 eligible turns.

ownerDecisions.question: Close the Phase 10/11 onboarding specs as superseded and retire the onb2 backup branches.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Yes: mark both specs superseded by onb3 and delete the backup branches after a diff.

ownerDecisions.question: compose_meal four-food-term cap and regional priors scope.
ownerDecisions.recommendation: Keep the four-term cap; defer regional priors.

themes: Wrong numbers first: energy rule, TDEE intake, portion maths and first-client constants
Safety rules on every write path: pace holds, allergens, diet rules, coach and import parity
Tenancy and data loss: RLS lockdown, media paths, sync merge and outbox, exports and backup
Production ledger and owner steps gate merged code (migrations, secrets, repo visibility)
Scale for the next 1,000 users: measure, alert, budget, indexes, fan-out, change_log compaction
Open-world release is built but gated on owner labels, human reviews and clinical sign-off
Verification debt: device journeys, authenticated browser rows, CI guards that cannot fail
